fusions.name: Vaulting Stoop
fusions.desc: You vault on the staff up to 7 tiles onto a target and strike down on it. It deals 12 damage, rising to 1.8 times that from full range.

fusions.name: Whirled Overhead
fusions.desc: Whirls the staff overhead. It deals 3 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles, and the lift moves you 10% faster for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Flown From the Perch
fusions.desc: Casts a hawk off the head of the staff for 10 seconds. It swoops on an enemy within 5 tiles for 3 damage every second.

fusions.name: Walker's Tailwind
fusions.desc: Your movement speed is permanently increased by 10%.
